About the Health Career Photography event

Health Career Photography is a Leadership event in the HOSA secondary division. Format: speech & presentation · online submission.

Ten in-depth lessons for the HOSA Health Career Photography solo event, following the 2026–27 guidelines: choosing three health professionals in three different fields, obtaining facility and subject permissions and protecting privacy, camera exposure, focus and color, composition and storytelling, shooting safely in health care settings, ethical editing and 8″ × 10″ printing, writing one-page narratives, assembling the 13-page portfolio and PDF (165 points), the required display time and the five-minute Round Two presentation (110 points). Includes composition, exposure, editing-rule and timing drills and practice scenarios.
